source_cleaned_reference.saved_notebook_kpi_note: The saved executive_kpis.csv records 19,561 invoices, while its matching clean CSV and independent raw rebuild contain 19,559. Dashboard metrics use the row-verified clean CSV count; the stored summary appears stale.

quality.cleaning_policy: Follows the RetailIQ notebook: removes exact duplicate copies, return-like rows, missing/invalid item, date, quantity, or price rows; keeps anonymous positive sales for sales totals and excludes them from RFM.

definitions.average_order_value: Positive-line sales proxy divided by distinct retained invoice numbers.
definitions.rfm: Anonymous rows are excluded; recency uses one day after the last retained transaction.
definitions.market_basket: Association values are co-occurrence measures, not causal recommendations.
